Playwright 1.64.1, 1 worker per shard, retries 0, suite `tests@3259c416b64e playwright.config.ts@372695034943 package-lock.json@402b909d1dbd`. `fullyParallel` is off in that `playwright.config.ts`. 20 runs. Times are seconds. Job times come from the GitHub Actions API, Playwright times from each shard’s blob report.

## Summary

Medians over the runs of each arm. The ideal bound is the balanced lower bound for the slowest shard’s Playwright time. "vs native" compares a median with the native median at the same shard count. `smart` runs are the ones the Action balanced from its history; the cold start is the first smart run, which had no history and ran native sharding; `rollback` ran the smart workflow with `enabled: false`. `@sha` is the Action commit.

## Ideal bound

From the median duration of each test over the native runs: 420.9 s of test time outside the setup project, 3.0 s of setup that every shard runs, and a longest indivisible unit of 55.0 s (`chromium › e2e/checkout-payments.spec.ts`). The bound is setup + max(total / shards, longest unit).

| Shards | Total / shards | Longest unit | Ideal bound |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 105.2 s | 55.0 s | 108.2 s |
| 8 | 52.6 s | 55.0 s | 58.0 s |
